tasks.title: Let pet owners book appointments online

messages.text: Task: pet owners phone the front desk to book. Offer online booking for routine appointments (vaccinations, check-ups), with the clinic's opening hours and each vet's calendar.

Proposal: routine appointment types bookable online in 15-minute slots from each vet's calendar, with the pet chosen from the owner's account; surgery and emergencies stay phone only. Proposal review requested.
Leave out choosing a specific vet for now; the clinic assigns them.
Revised the proposal without vet choice and asked for a second proposal review, since the slot logic changed: slots are now pooled across vets.
Merged: PR #250. Owners book routine appointments online in pooled slots; the clinic assigns the vet.

findings.title: Slot length should follow the appointment type

tasks.title: Remind owners when vaccinations are due

messages.text: Task: send owners a reminder four weeks before a pet's vaccination is due, with a booking link.
Proposal: a daily job reading due dates from the vaccination records, email four weeks and one week before, with a link that opens online booking for a vaccination. Question about text messages.
Email only for now.
Thanks. Your answer leaves one case open that I'd otherwise guess at.
Then a letter is fine, the desk prints them weekly. No calls.
Merged: PR #252. Owners with email get emails; those without go on the weekly letter list for the desk.

questions.text: Should reminders also go by text message, or email only?
About a fifth of owners have no email address on file: should they get a printed letter, a call from the desk, or nothing?

tasks.title: Chart each pet's weight over time

messages.text: Task: vets want a weight chart on the pet's record, from the weights taken at each visit.
Proposal: a line chart from the visit weights with the breed's healthy range shaded where we have one. Tests with a puppy's growth and an adult cat.
Pushed PR #254, then had to push again: the migration number 0031 clashed with the one the booking task merged this morning. Renumbered to 0032. Merged: PR #254.
Task: vets work out doses by hand from weight. Add a calculator for the clinic's common medicines, showing the dose and the wording for the label.
Proposal: a calculator on the pet's record with the clinic's medicine list, dose per kilogram and maximum dose, and label wording generated from the result. Every result shows the inputs used.
Ready and green. Asking for merge approval.
Not yet. The head vet wants to read every label wording first; I'll approve once she has.
Approved, wording signed off.
Merged: PR #256.

events.reason: Operator held approval until the head vet signs off the label wording

messages.text: Task: a screen in the waiting room showing which pet is called next, by first name only.
Proposal: a read-only queue view for a wall screen, pet first names and a room number when called, nothing else. Proposal review requested.
Add the vet's name next to the room. People ask which vet they're seeing.
Updated the proposal with the vet's name beside the room, and asked for a second proposal review since it now shows staff names on a public screen.
Merged: PR #258.

findings.title: Vet names should be the display name the vet chose

tasks.title: Import lab results into pet records

messages.text: Task: blood test results come back from the outside lab as files. Import them into the pet's record.
Proposal: read the lab's result files from the shared drop folder, match them to the pet by the request number, show the values with the lab's reference ranges and flag out-of-range values.
The owner was blocked for 40 minutes by the engine provider's outage this morning, which their status page lists; resumed once it cleared. Nothing else affected.
Merged: PR #260. Had to push twice, migration 0034 clashed with the weight chart's follow-up. Results import, match by request number and flag out-of-range values.
Task: produce an itemised invoice at the end of a visit from the treatments and medicines recorded.
Proposal: invoice lines from the visit's treatments and dispensed medicines with the price list in effect on the visit date, tax per line, printable and emailable. Proposal review requested.
Insurance claims need the diagnosis on the invoice too.
Added the diagnosis to the invoice layout and requested a second proposal review for the change.
Merged: PR #262.
Task: show a photo of the pet at the top of its record, so staff recognise it.
Proposal: owners or staff upload a photo, resized and stored privately, shown on the record and the waiting list.
Merged: PR #264.
Task: owners sign a paper consent form before surgery. Let them sign on a tablet at the desk.
Proposal: a consent form per procedure from the clinic's templates, signed on a tablet with the owner's name, stored on the visit and printable.
Merged: PR #266 on the second push; migration 0036 clashed again with another task's. Renumbered.
Task: mark appointments as no-shows and show the count on the owner's account, so the desk can ask for a deposit from repeat no-shows.
Proposal: a no-show action on past appointments, a count per owner over the last year shown on the account, and a note at booking when the count is three or more.
Merged: PR #268.
Task: the clinic closes on public holidays and opens late on some days. Let the desk set exceptions to the opening hours.
Proposal: dated exceptions (closed, or different hours) that online booking and the reminders respect.
Merged: PR #270.

current.title: Switch database migrations to timestamped names

chat.text: Migration numbers clash every few days. Can we stop numbering them by hand?
Dispatched a task to switch migrations to timestamped names.
No-shows and holiday hours today please.

earlier.title: Owners skip the second proposal review when only the scope changed
